section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex / AGA / Model Grant Agreement template used as governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B sources.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing any Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed; absent/failed budget artifacts are a blocking gate failure.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Audited artifact is a Phase 8 artifact (schema_id 'orch.phase8.drafting_review_status.v1') reporting completed Phase 8 drafting and review: section_completion_log marks excellence, impact and implementation all with "status": "final" and "data_gaps_flagged": false, and revision_log records an executed revision cycle (L-1..L-12, performed_at 2026-09-03T12:00:00Z). Budget-dependent effort figures appear as confirmed values in change_description of A-5/L-5: "per-WP effort totals (WP1 9.0, WP3 6.6, WP4 6.0 PM) and partner in-kind PM". However docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json has "gate_pass_declaration": "fail" with blocking inconsistency BLK-01 ("received/ contains no lump-sum budget response ... Absent budget artifacts in received/ constitute a blocking gate failure"). Phase 8 activity has therefore commenced while the budget gate is failed, violating CLAUDE.md §13.4 and §8.4.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority by redefining phase/tier/gate meanings.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow progress with incomplete inputs.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe rules as a substitute for Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1-4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.
